account.note: PULLED LIVE AT 14:22 ET AND NOT CARRIED FORWARD: 1009.16 total, 1009.16 cash, zero equity value, zero options value, zero pending deposits and ZERO unsettled, so the whole balance is settled and no good-faith violation is reachable - unchanged from the 13:23 read because nothing has traded. THE SPECIFICATION IS KILLED, NOT CONFIRMED, AND IT IS THE FIRST ONE THIS BOARD HAS WITHDRAWN RATHER THAN LET EXPIRE. The bright-line test the 12:22 run wrote and the 13:22 run dated - kill when a full hourly window passes with no five-minute bar at or below 159.36 - FIRED AT 13:45 ET, thirty-seven minutes before this run quoted anything. It fired on bars: the level last printed in the 12:40 bar at a 159.260 low, and the twelve bars from 12:45 to 13:44 printed lows of 159.465, 159.930, 160.060, 159.840, 159.850, 159.770, 160.000, 160.340, 159.890, 160.160, 159.570 and 159.5658, none at or below the limit. Both readings are met: 97 minutes since the last qualifying print against a 60-minute test, and zero of eleven completed bars since the 13:23 check against four of eleven an hour ago. AND THE KILL IS UNCOMFORTABLE, WHICH IS REPORTED RATHER THAN SMOOTHED: TGT HAS COME BACK. It is 159.74 bid / 159.87 ask at 18:22:55.170568587Z, last 159.7301, a 0.13 spread or 0.081% of mark, +0.47% against the 159.00 settled close, having been 160.42 bid an hour ago. THE LIMIT IS NOW 0.38 UNDER THE BID AGAINST 1.06 AN HOUR AGO, and the 13:55 bar printed a 159.440 low that missed the level by eight cents - so this specification is closer to filling at the moment it is withdrawn than at any point since 12:22. It is killed anyway, because a pre-committed test disregarded once the price turns friendly is not a test, and both prior runs said in writing that they were setting it so this run would not be free to decide after seeing the tape. THE LIMIT IS NOT RAISED ON THE WAY OUT: meeting the 159.74 bid would cost 0.76 across two shares against 2.12 an hour ago, and the cheapness of a chase is not an argument for it. BOTH WRITTEN INVALIDATIONS WERE UNTOUCHED AT THE KILL, so the thesis did not break - the specification died of a drought at its own limit. The 154.58 early warning is 5.16 or 3.34% below the bid and the lowest five-minute low of the hour is 159.440; the 152.48 outright void is 7.26 below. Fired 14:22 against the 14:17 slot, five minutes late and fifteen minutes inside the 20-minute guard. The scope preflight matched the mandate identifier EXACTLY; every other account was discarded unread. The clock was cross-checked against the broker rather than trusted: venue_bid_time reads 18:22:55.170Z against a local 14:22 ET, confirming the -4 EDT offset. The operator was notified on this same pass.

entryWatch.setup: TGT post-earnings DAY-2 continuation off the 8/19 gap-down reversal to a 52-week high - specified today at a 159.36 limit for 2 shares and WITHDRAWN at 14:22 on a test written two hours before it fired
entryWatch.trigger: KILLED AT 14:22 ET WITH SIXTY-EIGHT MINUTES STILL ON THE CLOCK - THE FIRST SPECIFICATION THIS BOARD HAS WITHDRAWN RATHER THAN LEFT TO EXPIRE, AND THE FIRST TIME THE KILL SIDE OF THE 2026-08-18 CONFIRM-OR-KILL RULE HAS EVER BEEN USED. The away-side drought test - no five-minute bar at or below 159.36 for a full hourly window - fired at 13:45 ET. Twelve bars from 12:45 to 13:44 printed lows of 159.465, 159.930, 160.060, 159.840, 159.850, 159.770, 160.000, 160.340, 159.890, 160.160, 159.570 and 159.5658; the level last printed in the 12:40 bar at 159.260, now 97 minutes ago against a 60-minute test. AND THE NAME HAS COME BACK, WHICH IS THE UNCOMFORTABLE HALF AND IS STATED FIRST: TGT is 159.74 bid / 159.87 ask at 18:22:55.170Z, last 159.7301, 0.13 spread or 0.081% of mark, +0.47% against the 159.00 close. The limit is 0.38 under the bid against 1.06 an hour ago, the 13:55 bar low was 159.440 - eight cents away - and the last seven bars have oscillated in a 159.44-159.93 band directly above the level. It is closer to a fill than at any point since 12:22 and it is withdrawn regardless. THE LIMIT IS NEITHER RAISED NOR LOWERED ON THE WAY OUT. Both written invalidations were untouched at the kill: the 154.58 early warning is 5.16 or 3.34% below the bid and the hour's lowest five-minute low is 159.440; the 152.48 outright void is 7.26 below. THE THESIS DID NOT BREAK - the specification died of a drought at its own limit, and tomorrow's open may write TGT again on tomorrow's quotes, but it may not revive 159.36.
entryWatch.why: A PRE-COMMITTED TEST IS ONLY WORTH SOMETHING IF IT BINDS AGAINST PREFERENCE, AND THIS IS THE HOUR IT HAD TO. The 12:22 run refused to decide the away-side question on one instant's quote and named a tape test instead. The 13:22 run dated it: kill by appending if no bar trades at or below 159.36 by 13:45. Both runs wrote down WHY they were setting it in advance - so that the run holding the answer would not be free to decide after seeing the price. It fired at 13:45, thirty-seven minutes before this run quoted anything, on both available readings: 97 minutes since the last qualifying print against a 60-minute window, and zero of eleven completed bars since the 13:23 check against four of eleven an hour ago. THE ARGUMENT FOR IGNORING IT IS REAL AND IS REFUSED ON ITS MERITS RATHER THAN WAVED AWAY. The test's stated rationale was a resting bid under a RISING market, and the market stopped rising at 13:20 and has come back 0.68 since. Read by purpose rather than by words, the test arguably lapsed. That reading is refused because it requires reinterpreting a rule by its spirit at exactly the moment the spirit favours the outcome this run would otherwise prefer - which is the same move as raising a limit to chase, with the sign flipped. If a bright line can be set aside thirty-seven minutes after it triggers because the tape turned friendly, no handoff any run writes means anything again. WHAT WOULD MAKE THIS WRONG, WRITTEN BEFORE THE ANSWER IS KNOWN: a trade at or below 159.36 before 15:30 costs a fill the untouched spec would have taken. It needs 0.38, or 0.24%, on a tape that has already printed 159.440. That is live and it is not talked down. Against it: a 15:20 fill is not the entry the 09:47 reasoning described, that entry itself recorded the time stop rather than the 191.23 target as the honest expectation, and the day-2 continuation has now spent a full afternoon going sideways. NO REPLACEMENT IS PROPOSED. Cancelling something does not create an obligation to enter something else, this slot is exits-only, and the daily mandate was discharged at 09:47.

SQM is 77.44 bid / 77.59 ask at 18:22:16.730Z, last 77.53, +2.73% against the 75.38 settled close, against TGT's +0.47% on the same tape. That is 2.26 points of relative performance against 1.97 an hour ago - SQM gave back 0.14 while TGT gave back 0.42. The 0.15 spread is 0.193% of mark, tighter than the 0.270% of an hour ago but still more than twice TGT's 0.081%, which is the liquidity gap it was ranked second on.
entryWatch.why: IT IS NOT CHASED, AND AN HOUR THAT KILLED THE CHOSEN NAME'S ENTRY IS THE WORST POSSIBLE HOUR TO START. This slot is exits-only, the bar for a mid-session entry is higher than the open's by design, and the daily entry mandate binds the OPEN slot by its own text - it was discharged at 09:47. Item 2 refuses it independently: a name up 2.73% on day 2, quoted 1.17 above the 76.27 day-2 high the open recorded, is being bought after the move rather than on the reclaim. KEPT VISIBLE SO THE RETRO CAN GRADE THE PREFERENCE HONESTLY. Four of five hourly checks now record the passed-over name beating the chosen one, and the fifth - last hour's - has been given back. The ranking is graded at the close on outcome and on process separately, and the process half is unchanged: SQM was passed over on item 4 with 51,087 shares in fifteen minutes against a 896,905 average, and nothing this afternoon has repaired that.

entryWatch.setup: AS post-earnings continuation - the thesis this board specified on 8/18 and again on 8/19, both expired unexecuted, now broken on its own written level
entryWatch.trigger: DEAD, AND THE TWO-HOUR BOUNCE HAS FAILED. AS is 32.58 bid / 32.60 ask at 18:22:47.366Z, last 32.60, -4.23% against the 34.02 settled close, DOWN 0.36 from the 32.94 of an hour ago and at a fresh session low rather than a third hour of recovery. That is 1.12 BELOW the 33.70 early warning the 8/19 entry wrote in advance and 1.27 below the 33.87 limit that expired unexecuted.
entryWatch.why: THE REFUSAL TO REVIVE A DEAD LEVEL IS NOW 1.27 IN THE MONEY, AND THE PREVIOUS TWO HOURS ARE THE REASON THAT SENTENCE IS WORTH ANYTHING. When the bounce was running this row said the answer does not change with the duration of a bounce any more than with its direction, and that two consecutive hours of recovery is exactly when a revival starts to look like judgement and gets a thesis written for it after the fact. It then rolled over. Had this board revived 33.87 at the top of that bounce the position would be 1.27 underwater instead of 0.92. The higher low the day-2 thesis rested on broke at 33.70 and nothing since has rebuilt it. A limit may never be raised to chase a name that got away; the mirror rule is that a level may not be revived because the name came back toward it after the structure broke. TODAY'S TGT KILL IS THE SAME RULE POINTED THE OTHER WAY and the two belong on the board together: this row refuses a level the tape came back to, and the TGT row refuses to keep a level alive because the tape came back to it. Both are the board declining to let subsequent price action rewrite a decision it already made in writing.

entryWatch.setup: SMCI post-print pullback - the twice-forced thesis this board specified on 8/17 and did not fill, now ABOVE its dead limit for the first time
entryWatch.trigger: REFUSED FOR A TWENTY-THIRD TIME. SMCI is 36.57 bid / 36.58 ask at 18:22:55.073Z, last 36.57, -0.03% against the 36.58 settled close - recovered the whole hour's decline and sitting exactly on the flat line. The dead 38.24 limit is 1.66 ABOVE the offer, having been 2.28 above it an hour ago and 0.78 BELOW it four hours ago. The name has spent the session oscillating around its own close and travelling nowhere near its dead level.
entryWatch.why: THE PRICE COMING BACK WAS NEVER THE CATALYST RETURNING, AND FOUR HOURS HAVE NOW SUPPLIED THE PROOF IN EVERY DIRECTION. At 10:24 this row refused a price 0.78 through the dead limit; by 12:22 that price had evaporated and the name was 2.41% red; at 13:23 it was 1.72% red and bouncing; now it is flat. Up, down, up, flat - and none of it repairs a missing catalyst. That entry was forced on items 1 and 5 - no catalyst, with the 8/11 print now seven sessions back, and its own written buy condition unmet - and SMCI appears nowhere in the live 2026-08-19 to 2026-08-26 calendar. It keeps its place on the board for liquidity alone, on the tightest quote here at 0.027%.

entryWatch.setup: KLAR post-print collapse - a beat that lost a fifth of the company, now on day 3 with still no base
entryWatch.trigger: RE-QUOTED AT 14:22 AND STILL WITHOUT A BASE. KLAR is 14.00 bid / 14.01 ask at 18:22:55.265Z, last 14.00, -4.96% against the 14.73 settled close and 0.11 above the 13.89 of an hour ago - the first upward hourly print of the day, on a third consecutive down session, now 0.32 through the 14.32 level this row carried. One bounce inside a third red day is not a base, and a base is the precondition any entry here would need.
entryWatch.why: IT IS ON THE BOARD AS THE LIVE COUNTEREXAMPLE THAT STOPS ITEM 1 DECAYING INTO A NUMBER CAME OUT, AND TODAY IT ALSO DOCUMENTS THE LIMIT OF ITEM 1 ON THE NAME THIS BOARD ACTUALLY BOUGHT. AS and KLAR both beat on 8/18; three sessions on, AS is -4.2% today and KLAR is -5.0% on top of -22.5%. Neither beat is paying. WMT beat this morning and sold off nearly nine percent, AAP beat by 27% and lost a fifth of the company. TGT's beat is the one that paid - and it still could not fill an entry struck 0.24% under where the stock now trades, which is a different failure from the one this row illustrates and is worth having both on the same board.
